source.title: Londonderry Sentinel, 19 May 1955, p. 4 ("Contests in Londonderry, Limavady and Coleraine: three Limavady R.D.C. seats to be contested; full list of nominations"); Derry Journal, 18 May 1955, p. 2 ("Limavady Rural Council: four seats will be contested; full list of nominations"); Londonderry Standard, 20 May 1955, p. 5 ("Limavady Rural battle: Drumraighland withdrawal; H. Marshall returned unopposed"); Derry Journal, 10 June 1958, p. 5 ("Notice of result of elections: Rural District of Limavady, 1958 (Returning Officer's notice)")
source.publisher: Londonderry Sentinel (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: returned unopposed: the nominations list prints 'Faughanvale - Hugh Marshall ... (U.). The sitting member, Mr. M. Mitchell, J.P., is not seeking re-election' (Londonderry Sentinel 19 May 1955 p4; Derry Journal 18 May 1955 p2), a second 'Faughanvale' after Askin's; the Londonderry Standard (20 May 1955 p5) says that in Mitchell's division 'Mr. H. Marshall, was returned unopposed'.

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 2 June 1955. Three contests; the report says there were three, although an earlier nominations report had expected four (Derry Journal, 3 June 1955, p. 1). Eleven unopposed members added (Aghanloo to Gelvin) from the full nominations list (Derry Journal, 18 May 1955, p. 2; Londonderry Sentinel, 19 May 1955, p. 4), whose printed text stops at Gelvin; Glenshane, Keady, Killywool, Lislane, Myroe, Owenreagh, Scriggan, Straw and The Highlands are not yet found (round-2 gap-fill, 7 Nov 2026). The list prints the division as 'Faughanvale', in error: Faughanvale is Constantine Askin's, listed just before, and Matthew Mitchell, the retiring member Marshall replaced, sat for Foreglen (Derry Journal, 20 May 1949: Mitchell 'was to have been challenged in the Foreglen Division'); the 1958 Returning Officer's notice (Derry Journal, 10 June 1958, p. 5) returns Hugh Marshall for Foreglen. Returned unopposed.
